verdict.rationale: PayPal documents several hosted payment surfaces that spare the developer from building a payment UI. Payment Links can be shared on a website with "no coding skills required", and invoices are paid "through a secure PayPal payment page, without building their own payment flow." The PayPal button lets customers pay with any linked funding source, and conversion is supported by Fastlane guest autofill and reach to 400M users. However, no evidence explicitly documents a server-created checkout session that redirects to a PayPal-hosted page, and the button flow is embedded on the merchant's site. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a redirect-to-hosted-checkout flow with return/cancel URLs, evidence of hosted-page branding or customization for checkout, and independent or hands-on corroboration of conversion optimization.
